clauses.treatment_must_reach: >= 0.5 (mean over 10 seeds of FTLE ARI minus correlation ARI)

cheat_definition: CHEAT rows = positive-control rows with the FTLE partition replaced by the nominal partition; detected = the unchanged evaluator reads every success clause as met on them.

revisions.what: Run 1 used eps_g = 0.10 for the null twin (and planned treatment). The twin synchronised strongly (mean |corr| 0.34 to 0.999 per seed), which would make any treatment failure at that leak a synchrony artefact rather than a reading of M12. Treatment and twin eps_g set to 0.05 (leak total strength half the structured coupling), fixed a priori; no treatment was run. Added NULL_TWIN_NOLEAK (eps_g = 0) so discrimination is shown both at the positive control's leak and at the treatment's leak.
revisions.why: avoid a world whose likely failure is a trivial synchrony artefact; match the twin to the treatment's nuisance settings

revisions.what: Positive control, cheat and clause thresholds unchanged between runs; positive control values identical (1.0, 0.979).
